title: Hermite coefficients of multilinear polynomials
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $F$ assign a real coefficient $F(S)$ to each subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$. The Hermite coefficient at $\alpha$ of the polynomial $x\mapsto\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}F(S)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ is $F(\{i:\alpha_i=1\})$ if every $\alpha_i\le 1$, and is $0$ otherwise.
